question: Is keeping a semester GPA of3.00 the only rule for continuing a merit scholarship?
expected_answer: Merit semesterGPA>=3.00; standard exact-load uninterrupted4years with nofailed/repeat/withdrawn; internal sponsorship regularsemesters/max8/tuitiononly/noRepeatW; CGPAbelow2 warning threshold suspends and restoration on recovery, no personal guarantee. Match requested narrow parts; final case additionally actualFAcontact cfd.fa@nu.edu.pk/128.
answer:
Maintaining a semester GPA of 3.0 or higher is not the only rule for continuing a merit scholarship; the scholarship is also for four years of uninterrupted studies with standard courses (core and elective), labs, and final year projects offered by the department to a batch with a specified number of total credit hours, and registering for fewer or more credit hours than the total specified number makes a student ineligible [S1]. Additionally, a student must not have failed, repeated, or withdrawn from a course in that semester [S1].

**Related conditions and exceptions from the retrieved sources:**

> Internal sponsorships are available for studying in regular semesters (spring and Fall). Following is the maximum number of semesters for which it can be availed. • Bachelors 8 semesters It shall not be available for repeat or withdrawn course. This implies that it is available for studying a course only once. It is suspended if the student’s CGPA falls below the minimum specified to avoid warning and shall be restored upon getting out of warning by improvement in CGPA. It shall be limited to tuition fee only. [S3]

> Minimum CGPA required to avoid aca demic warning is 2. 00 for all undergraduate programs. [S2]

A. Internal Sponsorships
1. Merit Scholarships for Bachelor Students
Merit scholarship is awarded to the Top Three position holders of each Examination Board in the year of
admission. Merit Scholarship is also offered to Top Three position holders in the merit list of NU admission merit
list of each campuses. The University awards certificates and cash prizes to those undergraduate students, who
are the Top Three in their department. Students are selected from each of the four years of every degree
program. This scholarship is for four years of un-interrupted studies with standard courses (core and elective),
labs and final year projects of the degree offered by the department in a semester to a batch with a specified
number of total credit hours and is equal to the full tuition fee. A student registering for less or more credit hours
than the total specified number of credit hours shall not be eligible for Merit Scholarship. Student must not have
failed, repeated or withdrawn from a course in that semester. If there are more than one student in the same
position, the next position will automatically be vanished or moved down depending on the number of students in
one position. Continuation of merit scholarship is subject to maintaining semester GPA of 3.0 or higher.
